name: pgvector Open-Source PostgreSQL Extension
free_limit: Free PostgreSQL-licensed extension for exact and approximate vector similarity search inside PostgreSQL 13+; supports HNSW and IVFFlat indexes, multiple vector types and distance metrics without a vendor-imposed software quota.
watch_out: Requires a PostgreSQL installation with extension support; some managed Postgres providers may not enable it or may charge for database compute and storage. Embedding generation and operations are separate.
